# RankLocal (ranklocall.com)

> RankLocal is a US pay-per-call lead generation marketplace. We sell exclusive,
> live inbound phone calls and qualified form leads to home service contractors
> (roofing, HVAC, plumbing, pest control, landscaping, fencing, garage door) and
> business funding buyers (MCA funders, ISOs, business loan brokers).
> One buyer per call - never shared. Pay per qualified call over 60 seconds.
> Calls come from Google and Bing local search, never social media.
> Start with a prepay of 10 billable calls. Campaigns go live within 72 hours.

## How it works
- Buyers set coverage area, daily cap, and hours; larger areas, longer hours and fewer disputes earn more volume
- A qualified (billable) call lasts over 60 seconds from the buyer's coverage area
- Disputes are reviewed within 48 hours
